name: proofstory-intent-ref-canonical-equivalence
title: Make ProofStory completeness resolve positional and authored verification-intent references to one canonical row
description: B-8de3 has 13 fresh tool-executed receipts keyed by immutable authored verificationIntent IDs, while its pre-DEV ProofStory acceptance contract references the same rows by CHK-xxx:lane:index. The REVIEW completeness gate compares raw strings and reports all 13 missing; the evidence writer correctly refuses fabricating positional evidence because only authored IDs resolve. Add one canonical intent-reference resolver consumed by ProofStory acceptance/completeness so authored IDs and valid positional refs identify the same row, while unknown, wrong-item, wrong-lane, out-of-range, duplicate, and ambiguous refs fail closed. Preserve immutable evidence pins and do not add a REVIEW-phase contract mutation bypass.
